dsh-whale-animation is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A 60-frame theme-aware monochrome whale-dive animation with reactive water for the DSH Web turn status: embedded assets, seamless closed-loop playback, a reduced-motion PNG fallback, and lifecycle-clean removal.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9d1347759f0f44a6bc6e.html
